Title: Official WotC VtES Web site is up!

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
WotC's official WWW page one VtES is finally up:

http://www.wizards.com/VTES/Welcome.html

(You have to turn on image loading if you use Netscape,
since the pages changes the text color to white without
changing the background color from light gray).

It doesn't have any information on it except for some
upcoming release dates and sparse background info (more
of an ad than a web page, actually) - but it's up,
nonetheless.

Here's hoping some rulings and card lists make it onto
the page before the name changes again :-).
